english:
Weapon Kills grant a stack of Killing Tally. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Stowing or reloading the weapon removes all stacks.

Damage increases by <pve 10%|20%|30% /> <pvp [5%|10%|15%] /> at 1|2|3 stacks.

enhanced (
<enhanced/> Passively grants 10 Magazine Stat, identical to Tactical Mag (none<arrow/>10).
)

source.text:
On Weapon Kill:
Grants a stack of Killing Tally, up to 3 stacks. 
Stacks are removed on stow or reload.

Killing Tally:
10% | 20% | 30% increased damage
5% | 10% | 15% increased damage

↑Passively grants +10 Magazine Stat (Identical to Tactical Mag).
